about: GTA 6 Lucia: since GTA III took the series 3D in 2001, every lead Rockstar wrote was a man (13 leads in 11 games, derived). The 1997 original let you pick a woman, but the pick was only cosmetic; GTA Online lets you create a woman, but she is a blank: no name, no past. Lucia Caminos co-leads GTA 6's story with Jason (Rockstar: 'Jason and Lucia's story'), with a past Rockstar wrote for her. Hero number: 25 years (2001 to 2026, derived). Delta channel, own graphics, no Rockstar art. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026.
